cases.rationale: Boundary comparison of measured school-bus speed across the 55 mph statutory cap, conditional on original school transportation evidence.

channels.name: ego_pose
channels.method: Original Native post-tick school-bus pose joined to four cameras
channels.uncertainty: Actor identity and original route require source review

channels.name: school_bus_speed
channels.method: Norm of original Native post-tick three-axis bus velocity
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; no invented legal tolerance

context_inputs.name: school_bus_driver_and_pupil_trip_review
context_inputs.method: Independent original bus design, judged-driver join, pupil and trip-purpose review

limitations: Requested speed is not measured speed.
A bus asset label does not prove statutory school-bus status.
Pupils aboard alone do not prove to/from-school purpose.
Synthetic diagnostic review does not establish original facts or a legal verdict.
